description: This file contains the implementation of an onboarding wizard view for an iOS app, managing user interactions for connecting a gateway device via QR code or manual setup, including states, UI flow, and connection logic.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: An enumeration representing the different onboarding steps, with properties to navigate, display titles, and determine navigation flow.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view struct implementing multi-step onboarding flow for gateway connection setup, including scan, manual setup, and success UI states.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for selecting connection modes during onboarding, displaying radio-like checkmarks.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Handles the data from a scanned QR code or deep link, extracting connection parameters and initiating connection attempt.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares and presents the QR code scanner interface, cancelling any ongoing connection attempts.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Handles user action to resume connection attempt after pairing approval on the gateway.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing process if conditions are met, such as app being active and in the correct state.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Uses CoreImage to detect and extract a QR code message from raw image data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Transitions from intro step to welcome step after user acknowledgment.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates back to previous onboarding step when applicable.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway asynchronously, managing UI state accordingly.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Sets the selected connection mode and applies related default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Sets default host, port, and TLS settings based on selected mode, to aid user configuration.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts manual connection to specified host and port, managing UI state during process.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries previous connection attempt, optionally silently, and manages connection state and UI messaging.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Stores gateway token and password persistently associated with the device instance ID.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores bootstrap token for gateway setup, used during QR code or deep link processing.
